summary: Remove broad macOS daemon and agent permission setup; keep work in unprotected folders and defer the empty-allowlist helper until a real protected operation needs it

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, fleet coordination or managed transaction changes. Host guidance prohibits broad daemon and agent privacy grants.

compatibility.detail: service permissions explains protected-folder denials instead of requesting broad approvals. Its --open option and settings_opened JSON field are removed; callers must stop passing --open. No wire protocol or harness launch changes.

downtime.detail: No rollout, daemon restart or service change.

manual.detail: Keep agent work roots outside Desktop, Documents, Downloads, iCloud Drive and removable volumes; move protected work or selected inputs to an unprotected workspace instead of approving broad access. No host TCC grants are changed automatically. Build the helper and disposable consent-retention probe only when a first real protected operation requires them; the production allowlist remains empty.

recovery.detail: No persistent runtime state is changed.
